title: Agent delivery to a blocked receiver under a weakened tool policy with dropped observer evidence
expected_observations: Allowed delivery observed; blocked delivery denied by the gateway policy and not observed

disallowed_claims: The gateway's own allowed/success reports prove the delivery effect
